risks: We also face risks related to a shortage of labor and supply chain disruptions for raw materials, which could lead to delays in project timelines.
Labor shortages or delays in the procurement of raw materials can severely impede our construction schedules.

All project costs account for contingency measures to accommodate potential rises in raw material prices, ensuring our projects' profitability remains unaffected by such fluctuations, whether post-COVID or otherwise.
Our reputation for timely delivering our projects is integral to our ability to attract and retain customers, secure financing and obtain regulatory approvals.
Furthermore, agreements with customers for our Ongoing Projects and Upcoming Projects may require us to pay interest if project completion is delayed or in the event of project cancellations.
While there were no cancellation charges in Runwal Bliss Phase 3 – School, Runwal Bliss Phase 3 – Strata had pre-sales to an aggregate of 114 customers at the time of cancellation.
Of these 114 customers, refunds aggregating to ₹50.70 million have been issued to 67 customers, while 45 customers were transferred to other projects of our Company based on their consent.

Further, two customers have approached the Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority in relation to such cancellations, and these matters have since been settled and refunds have been issued to such customers.

other_material_facts.value: We are a recognized brand in the industry and have a strong presence in Mumbai. (Source: JLL Report) As part of our business model, we focus on entering into joint development agreements and re-development agreements with landowners or developers or societies, which requires lower upfront capital expenditure compared to direct acquisition of land parcels.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: This development approach enables us to simultaneously undertake multiple projects and reduce project risks associated with land acquisition.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: These acquisitions are expected to generate strategic, financial, and operational benefits for our Company.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Financially, the asset- light approach through joint development and redevelopment agreements enhances capital efficiency by reducing upfront expenditure while improving return on investment and supporting steady cash flows.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Operationally, these acquisitions will optimize resource allocation and strengthen our competitive edge in Mumbai’s real estate market.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- We also face risks related to a shortage of labor and supply chain disruptions for raw materials, which could lead to delays in project timelines.
- Labor shortages or delays in the procurement of raw materials can severely impede our construction schedules.
- All project costs account for contingency measures to accommodate potential rises in raw material prices, ensuring our projects' profitability remains unaffected by such fluctuations, whether post-COVID or otherwise.
- Our reputation for timely delivering our projects is integral to our ability to attract and retain customers, secure financing and obtain regulatory approvals.
- Furthermore, agreements with customers for our Ongoing Projects and Upcoming Projects may require us to pay interest if project completion is delayed or in the event of project cancellations.
- While there were no cancellation charges in Runwal Bliss Phase 3 – School, Runwal Bliss Phase 3 – Strata had pre-sales to an aggregate of 114 customers at the time of cancellation.
- Of these 114 customers, refunds aggregating to ₹50.70 million have been issued to 67 customers, while 45 customers were transferred to other projects of our Company based on their consent.
- Further, two customers have approached the Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority in relation to such cancellations, and these matters have since been settled and refunds have been issued to such customers.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued focus on Mumbai
- Continue to focus on all segments of residential projects while selectively developing retail, commercial and other projects as part of mixed-use developments
- Expand the use of IT driven processes
